title.zh: 国家文物局（缩微与复制费用）条例
title.en: National Heritage Board (Micrographic and Reprographic Fees) Regulations

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。附表 1 篇以 900000+ 序号随同收录。

text.en: 1. These Regulations may be cited as the National Heritage Board (Micrographic and Reprographic Fees) Regulations.

2.—(1) There shall be paid to the Board in respect of the matters set out in the first column of the Schedule the fees set out in the second column thereof.
(2) The Board may in its discretion exempt from payment, in whole or in part, any fee under these Regulations.

THE SCHEDULE
Regulation 2
First column
Second Column
1. Negative microfilm
$3.20 per exposure for production of photoprint only.
2. Duplicate diazo microfilm —
(a) not exceeding 15 metres
$6 per metre or part thereof.
(b) exceeding 15 metres
$100 per roll of not more than 30 metres.
3. Diazo microfiche
$5 per microfiche.
4. Photographic print (photographic paper) from microfilm negative of a size —
(a) not exceeding A4 (21 cm x 29.7 cm)
(i) $8 per copy.
(ii) $6 per copy for students.
(b) not exceeding A3 (29.7 cm x 42 cm)
(i) $9.50 per copy.
(ii) $7.50 per copy for students.
(c) not exceeding A2 (42 cm x 59.4 cm)
(i) $16 per copy.
(ii) $13 per copy for students.
(d) not exceeding A1 (59.4 cm x 84.1 cm)
(i) $25 per copy.
(ii) $20 per copy for students.
5. Photographic print (plain paper) from microfilm of a size —
(a) not exceeding A4 (21 cm x 29.7 cm)
30 cents per copy.
(b) not exceeding A3 (29.7 cm x 42 cm)
40 cents per copy.
(c) not exceeding A2 (42 cm x 59.4 cm)
$4 per copy.
6. Photocopy of any document of a size —
(a) not exceeding B4 (25 cm x 35.3 cm)
30 cents per page.
(b) not exceeding A3 (29.7 cm x 42 cm)
40 cents per page.
7. C60 cassette tape
$6 per cassette tape.
8. Processing —
(a) 16 mm x 30.5 m roll film
$6 per roll.
(b) 35 mm x 30.5 m roll film
$9 per roll.
(c) 105 mm x 30.5 m roll film
$35 per roll.
9. Quality Control (Hypo) Test on 16/35/105 mm master negative sample strip
$15 per roll.
10. Quality Control (Resolution and Density) Test on 16/35/105 mm master negative
$15 per roll.
11.—(1) Microfilming of loose single-sided documents not exceeding A4 size in good physical condition (less than 5 years old) on 16 mm roll film
$50 per roll.
(2) Preparation prior to microfilming
$25.
12.—(1) Microfilming of loose single or double-sided documents not exceeding A3 size in fair physical condition (5 to 10 years old) on 16 mm roll film
$55 per roll.
(2) Preparation prior to microfilming
$30.
13.—(1) Microfilming of loose single or double-sided documents not exceeding A3 size in poor physical condition (more than 10 years old) on 16 mm roll film
$70 per roll
(2) Preparation prior to microfilming
$35.
14. Microfilming of single-sided 80 column or 132 column computer print-out (continuous run) in good physical condition (less than 5 years old) on 16 mm roll film
$45 per roll.
15.—(1) Microfilming of loose or bound documents (less than 10 cm in thickness) not exceeding A1 size in fair physical condition (5 to 10 years old) on 35 mm roll film
$150 per roll.
(2) Preparation prior to microfilming
$30.
16.—(1) Microfilming of plans or maps not exceeding A0 size in fair physical condition (5 to 10 years old) on 35 mm roll film
$110 per roll.
(2) Preparation prior to microfilming
$55.
17.—(1) Microfilming of loose documents not exceeding A3 size in good physical condition (less than 5 years old) on 105 mm roll fiche
$400 per roll.
(2) Preparation prior to microfilming
$100.
18.—(1) Microfilming of loose or bound documents (less than 2 cm in thickness) not exceeding A3 size in fair physical condition (5 to 10 years old) on 105 mm roll fiche
$370 per roll.
(2) Preparation prior to microfilming
$85.
19.—(1) Microfilming of loose or bound documents (less than 5 cm in thickness) not exceeding A3 size in good physical condition (less than 5 years old) on 105 mm cut fiche format
$16 per cut fiche.
(2) Preparation prior to microfilming
$1.60 per fiche.
19A.—(1) Microfilming of loose maps or plans on large format cut-sheet negative film —
(a) 4″ x 5″/4″ x 6″ sheet
$12 per sheet.
(b) 8″ x 10″ sheet
$15 per sheet.
(2) Preparation prior to microfilming —
(a) 4″ x 5″/4″ x 6″ sheet
$1.20 per sheet.
(b) 8″ x 10″ sheet
$1.50 per sheet.
20. Duplicate records belonging to departments/statutory boards —
(a) 16 mm diazo microfilm
$10 per roll.
(b) 35 mm diazo microfilm
$15 per roll.
(c) 105 mm cut fiche
$1.50 per fiche.
21. Deacidification of A4 size documents
$1 per sheet.
22. Restoration of A4 size documents —
(a) without leaf-casting
$8 per sheet.
(b) with leaf-casting
$15 per sheet.
23. Removal of stain of A4 size documents
$7 per sheet.
24. Encapsulation of A4 size documents
$7 per sheet.
25. Restoration of A4 size maps —
(a) without leaf-casting
$30 per sheet.
(b) with leaf-casting
$50 per sheet.
26. Fumigation of documents
$25 per cycle.
27. Binding of A4 size books —
(a) manually bound with leather
$115 per book.
(b) manually bound with cloth
$70 per book.
(c) machine bound
$8 per book.
28. Reproduction of black and white photographs of a size —
(a) 89 mm x 140 mm
$1.50.
(b) 102 mm x 152 mm
$2.50.
(c) 152 mm x 203 mm
$4.
(d) 203 mm x 254 mm
$7.
(e) 254 mm x 305 mm
$10.
(f) 305 mm x 381 mm
$15.
(g) 406 mm x 508 mm
$30.
(h) 508 mm x 610 mm
$45.
(i) Size bigger than 508 mm x 610 mm
15 cents per 645 mm2.
29. Reproduction of colour photographs of a size —
(a) 76 mm x 127 mm
$4.
(b) 127 mm x 127 mm
$6.
(c) 127 mm x 178 mm
$7.
(d) 203 mm x 203 mm
$14.
(e) 203 mm x 254 mm
$15.
(f) 279 mm x 356 mm
$25.
(g) 356 mm x 432 mm
$36.
(h) 406 mm x 508 mm
$40.
30. Reproduction of colour transcripts/slides of a size —
(a) 35 mm
$5.
(b) 57 mm x 57 mm
$25.
(c) 102 mm x 127 mm
$50.
31. Usage of photographs/slides —
(a) for commercial activities which are educational and cultural in nature and where the photographs/slides are not the main draw to the products/ services but are supplements. Commercial activities includes commercial illustrative purposes such as publications, television programmes and display purposes.
$50 per photograph per usage.
(b) in product development where the photographs/slides are the main draw to the products. Product development includes printing of photographs on T-shirts, mugs, calendars, picture postcards, and other souvenir merchandise items.
$500 per photograph per usage.
32. Search fee for audio-visual materials
$25 per programme.
33. Transfer cost for audio-visual materials —
(a) from Betacam master to Betacam copy
$200 per hour.
(b) from Betacam master to U-matic copy
$150 per hour.
(c) from 1’ master to VHS copy
$160 per copy.
(d) from 1’ master to U-matic copy
$175 per copy.
(e) from U-matic master to U-matic copy
$100 per copy.
(f) from VHS to VHS
$70 per copy.
34. Usage fee for audio-visual materials
$400 per programme per usage.
35. Black and white photocopying of a size —
(a) not exceeding A4
$2 per copy.
(b) not exceeding A3
$2.50 per copy.
36. Mono-colour photocopying of a size —
(a) not exceeding A4
$2.50 per copy.
(b) not exceeding A3
$3 per copy.
37. 4-Colour photocopying of a size —
(a) not exceeding A4
$3 per copy.
(b) not exceeding A3
$3.50 per copy.
38. Computer print-out of —
(a) photograph index/list or Oral History synopsis
$2.20 per A4 sheet.
(b) black and white photograph image
$2.70 per A4 sheet.
39. Direct duplication of —
(a) 16 mm x 30.5 m silver halide microfilm
$25 per roll.
(b) 35 mm x 30.5 m silver halide microfilm
$40 per roll.
40. Sulphate treatment (toning) of —
(a) 16 mm x 30.5 m silver halide film
$10 per roll.
(b) 35 mm x 30.5 m silver halide microfilm
$12 per roll.
[S 442/95 wef 30/09/1995]
